description: Hazmat Team 1 dispatched to Industrial Park, Unit 7 at Riverdale following reports of a chemical odor. On arrival, a 55-gallon drum of toluene was found to have a failing seal, resulting in a slow leak onto the concrete floor. Approximately 8 gallons released. Area evacuated, drum uprighted and overpacked. No injuries. Fire Marshal notified.
notes: Hazmat with chemical identification and no casualties.
